answer: A lagoon of per-task receipts records who did what, and the nebula of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Reaching the relic of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, clawed back after a replayed submission, no identity may audit its own recruit.
